SELECT d.id, d.stock_out_no, d.goods_type, d.goods_code, d.goods_name, d.goods_spec, d.unit, d.batch_no, d.expiry_date, d.serial_no, d.cost_price, d.cost_total, d.sales_price, d.sales_total, d.apply_qty, d.actual_qty, d.production_date, d.shelf_life, d.production_batch_no, d.over_flag, d.over_qty, d.source_type, d.remark as remark, d.create_time, m.stock_out_type, m.source_order_code, m.customer_name, m.warehouse_name, m.requester_name, m.consignee, m.consignee_phone, m.deliver_address, m.status, m.approve_status, m.stock_out_time, m.required_date, m.total_cost, m.total_sales, m.remark as master_remark FROM mis_stock_out_detail d LEFT JOIN mis_stock_out m ON d.stock_out_id = m.id
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

SELECT '合计' as stock_out_no, '合计' as goods_name, NULL as goods_code, NULL as goods_spec, NULL as unit, NULL as batch_no, SUM(d.apply_qty) as apply_qty, SUM(d.actual_qty) as actual_qty, SUM(d.cost_total) as cost_total, SUM(d.sales_total) as sales_total, SUM(d.over_qty) as over_qty, NULL as cost_price, NULL as sales_price, NULL as expiry_date, NULL as production_date, NULL as shelf_life, NULL as production_batch_no, NULL as over_flag, NULL as source_type, NULL as remark, NULL as create_time, NULL as stock_out_type, NULL as source_order_code, NULL as customer_name, NULL as warehouse_name, NULL as requester_name, NULL as consignee, NULL as consignee_phone, NULL as deliver_address, NULL as status, NULL as approve_status, NULL as stock_out_time, NULL as required_date, SUM(m.total_cost) as total_cost, SUM(m.total_sales) as total_sales, NULL as master_remark, NULL as id FROM mis_stock_out_detail d LEFT JOIN mis_stock_out m ON d.stock_out_id = m.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.cost_total), 0) FROM mis_stock_out o INNER JOIN mis_stock_out_detail d ON o.id = d.stock_out_id WHERE d.production_batch_id = #{batchId} AND o.stock_out_type = 'PRODUCTION' AND o.approve_status = '1' AND o.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0'
